metadata.name: SCNonResettingAdaptiveLIFNeuron
metadata.author: SC-NeuroCore project
metadata.description: Project affine-rest exact-relaxation adaptive LIF without voltage reset or refractory gating

dynamics.v: exp(-dt / tau_m) * v + (1 - exp(-dt / tau_m)) * (v_rest + r_m * I)
dynamics.theta: exp(-dt / tau_theta) * theta + (1 - exp(-dt / tau_theta)) * theta_rest + (delta_theta if exp(-dt / tau_m) * v + (1 - exp(-dt / tau_m)) * (v_rest + r_m * I) >= exp(-dt / tau_theta) * theta + (1 - exp(-dt / tau_theta)) * theta_rest else 0.0)
dynamics.spike_flag: 1.0 if exp(-dt / tau_m) * v + (1 - exp(-dt / tau_m)) * (v_rest + r_m * I) >= exp(-dt / tau_theta) * theta + (1 - exp(-dt / tau_theta)) * theta_rest else 0.0

extensions.source_equations: SC-NeuroCore retained project recurrence; no publication attribution
extensions.discretisation: Exact affine relaxation for voltage and threshold over each 0.1 ms sample
extensions.identity_note: Former NonResettingLIFNeuron behavior, retained explicitly during Model 50 source correction.
